# 🧾 Test Execution Report

## Run metadata

- Report ID:
- Feature / release:
- Exact commit SHA:
- Tester:
- Start / end time (UTC):
- Node.js and npm versions:
- Browser / device for manual tests:
- CI workflow and run URL:

## Scope

Describe tested files, behaviors, browsers, and exclusions. Link the test plan and acceptance criteria.

## Execution summary

| Check | Command / method | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Install | npm ci | pass / fail / blocked / not run | |
| Lint | npm run lint | | |
| Unit / repository tests | npm test | | |
| Documentation validation | npm run docs:check, if configured | | |
| Production build | npm run build | | |
| Dependency audit | npm audit --audit-level=high | | |
| Browser smoke | Manual | | |
| Accessibility | Manual | | |

## Detailed results

For each failed or blocked check, record the command, exit code, first actionable error, reproducibility, and owner.

## Manual verification

Record browser/version, viewport, input method, assistive technology, test steps, and actual observations. Keep screenshots free of private data.

## Defects

| Issue | Severity | Affected behavior | Owner | Retest result |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Conclusion

Pass / fail / partial / blocked. State what was verified and what remains unverified. Do not mark the run as passed because one subset of checks succeeded.
